tasks.label: UI Mod: Build + Hot Reload (ScriptEngine)
tasks.detail: THE build task. Compiles Assets/Scripts/StationeersUIMod (+ dev ScriptEngine shim) and drops StationeersUIMod.dll into BepInEx\scripts, after sweeping out any stale mod DLL. Press F6 in game, or wait ~3s for the watcher.
tasks.command: Remove-Item 'C:\Program Files (x86)\Steam\steamapps\common\Stationeers\BepInEx\scripts\StationeersUIAscended.dll' -Force -ErrorAction SilentlyContinue; dotnet build -c Debug

tasks.label: UI Mod: Clean ScriptEngine deploy
tasks.detail: Removes every UI-mod DLL from BepInEx\scripts, so ScriptEngine loads none of them.
tasks.command: $s='C:\Program Files (x86)\Steam\steamapps\common\Stationeers\BepInEx\scripts'; Remove-Item "$s\StationeersUIMod.dll","$s\StationeersUIAscended.dll" -Force -ErrorAction SilentlyContinue; Write-Host 'Cleared UI mod DLLs from BepInEx\scripts'; Get-ChildItem $s -Filter *.dll | Select-Object Name

tasks.label: UI Mod: Show what ScriptEngine will load
tasks.detail: Lists the DLLs in BepInEx\scripts. There must be exactly one UI-mod DLL (StationeersUIMod.dll).
tasks.command: Get-ChildItem 'C:\Program Files (x86)\Steam\steamapps\common\Stationeers\BepInEx\scripts' -Filter *.dll | Select-Object Name, Length, LastWriteTime | Format-Table -AutoSize
